messages:
Maya: Postmortem follow-up - we still need owners for pruning noisy alerts and locking down thresholds. Short thread to assign and record acceptance criteria.

Maya: Problems: exporter churn at 02:00 UTC, prediction-service flapping mem alerts, duplicate DB errors across AZs, and overly-chatty low-sev pages.

Tom: I can take the exporter churn. Plan: run 14d per-hour spike analysis, add a suppression window 01:30-03:30 UTC, and file a small fix to reduce retry noise in the exporter. Target: 2026-04-06.

Priya: I'll own prediction-service thresholds. Steps: gather 14d memory RSS/GC/OOM data, propose two thresholds (conservative/aggressive), smoke in staging for 72h, then roll. Target: 2026-03-31.

Andre: I'll pick up cross-AZ duplicate DB errors and the dedupe prototype. Idea: canonical signature = sha1(service + error_class + err_msg_prefix) with 20m window + visibility counters. Also draft a runbook line for ignored false-suppression. Target: 2026-04-08.

Maya: ops-bot, please create a ticket and add acceptance metrics: nightly_pager_count (baseline), unique_alert_signatures, suppressed_page_count, median_time_to_ack.

ops-bot: Created INFR-4812 assigned to <@Tom>, <@Priya>, <@Andre>. Due dates: Tom 2026-04-06, Priya 2026-03-31, Andre 2026-04-08.

Tom: PromQL I'll run: sum by(hour)(increase(alerts_fired_total{alertname=~"Exporter.*"}[14d])) - will upload CSV to INFR-4812.

Priya: Will include a revert play in the runbook if FP rate increases >2x. I'll post candidate thresholds + stagings metrics by EOD Friday.

Andre: Prototype config (WIP):
```
- name: az-dedupe-proto
  signature_fields: ["service","error.class","msg_prefix:20"]
  fingerprint: sha1
  window: 20m
  visibility: ["suppressed_count","last_seen"]
```
Will open RFC and include tests.

Maya: Great. Let's add a recurring 30m "Alert Cleanup" sync every 2 weeks starting 2026-03-30. ops-bot add ticket links and meeting.

ops-bot: Recurring meeting created: Alert Cleanup (biweekly) starting 2026-03-30 15:30 UTC. INFR-4812 linked.

Tom: uploading analysis now.

Priya: posting thresholds shortly.

Andre: branch + PR incoming tomorrow.

Maya: Thanks team — I'll notify Support + PM and close the loop after the first sync. :thumbsup:
